subject: ela
intro: Analyze foundational American literature and shared themes.

items.prompt:
A group of writers sharing ideas and style in a period is a literary:
A) movement
B) footnote
C) index

Emerson and Thoreau are associated with the:
A) Transcendentalist movement
B) printing press
C) jazz age only

Comparing two works from the same PERIOD reveals their shared:
A) themes and topics
B) page counts
C) fonts

Transcendentalist writers emphasized a shared theme of:
A) individual self-reliance and a bond with nature
B) industrial profit only
C) royal power
items.answer: A) individual self-reliance and a bond with nature

solution.answer: A) individual self-reliance and a bond with nature

items.prompt:
Why compare two works from the SAME period on a similar theme?
A) to see how writers of that era treated a common theme similarly and differently
B) to ignore the era
C) only to count pages
items.answer: A) to see how writers of that era treated a common theme similarly and differently

steps: Shared + varied treatment. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) to see how writers of that era treated a common theme similarly and differently

items.prompt:
A literary MOVEMENT is best defined as:
A) a shared style and set of ideas among writers of a period
B) a single poem
C) a printing method
items.answer: A) a shared style and set of ideas among writers of a period

steps: Group of writers. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) a shared style and set of ideas among writers of a period

items.prompt:
Two nineteenth-century American authors both write about the pursuit of the 'American Dream,' one celebrating it and one exposing its costs. Comparing them shows that:
A) writers of one era can share a theme yet reach different conclusions
B) they must agree
C) the theme has no meaning
items.answer: A) writers of one era can share a theme yet reach different conclusions

steps: Shared theme, different treatment. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) writers of one era can share a theme yet reach different conclusions

items.prompt:
Studying foundational American works across the 18th-early 20th centuries mainly helps a reader:
A) understand how literary traditions and themes developed over time
B) memorize page numbers
C) avoid reading
items.answer: A) understand how literary traditions and themes developed over time

solution.answer: A) understand how literary traditions and themes developed over time
